spans.s: वृज् (I) vt. 7P (pres. वृणक्ति) 1. To choose; 2. to lose, to abandon, to avoid; 3. to purify, तन्मेरेतः पिता वृंक्तामित्यस्यैतन्निदर्शनम् M.ix.20. (This root is very rarely used in classics; in the quotation from Manu, the word occurs not as Manu’s own but as part of a Vedie text.)
वृज् (II) vt. 2Ā (pres. वृक्ते) To avoid, to shun, e.g. वृणक्ति वृजिनः संगं वृक्तं च वृषलैः सह.

वृज् (III) vt. 1P, 10U (pres. वर्जति, वर्जयति-ते) 1. To abandon, to give up; 2. to abstain from, M.ii.177; 3. to shun, to avoid.With आ-, to bend, to incline, नूनमावर्ज्य दृष्टीः Megh.i.46; 2. to offer, R.i.62.With परि-, to avoid.With वि-, 1. to avoid; 2. to be destitute of.
वृजन (II) n. 1. Sin; 2. the sky; 3. a field cleared for pasture.
वृजिन (I) a. (f. ना) Crooked, curved, broken.
वृजिन (II) m. 1. Pain, digress; 2. hair; 3. a wicked wan.
वृजिन (III) n. Sin, सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवनैव वृजिनं संतरिष्यसि Bg.iv.36.
वृजिन (I) a. (f. ना) Crooked, curved, broken.
